name: Zalaistvánd (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of green over light grey, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalaistvánd (a white shield with a church tower and irises, between vine branches) below a scroll inscribed ZALAISTVÁND.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Zalaistvánd arms with branches and scroll
